info.name: Scalable E-Commerce System API
info.description: Postman collection for the Scalable E-Commerce System backend. Contains currently implemented endpoints for system liveness, dependency readiness, and Phase 5 user authentication.

exec: pm.test("Response body contains status UP and application name", function () {

request.description: Verifies that the backend Spring Boot process is running and responding to requests.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 OK (all dependencies UP) or 503 SERVICE UNAVAILABLE (degraded)", function () {
pm.test("Response payload contains application, mongodb, and redis statuses", function () {

request.description: Verifies connectivity to MongoDB and Redis dependencies. Returns 200 OK if both are UP, or 503 Service Unavailable if either is DOWN.

item.description: User registration, authentication, and token verification endpoints

item.name: Custom Key-Value Store
item.description: High-performance concurrency-safe in-memory key-value storage with TTL support.

request.description: Stores a key-value pair with an optional TTL in seconds.
Retrieves the value and metadata for an existing key.
Lists all active, unexpired keys in the in-memory store.
Deletes a key from the key-value store.

item.name: Data Sharding
item.description: Consistent-hashing based logical shard routing and rebalance simulation.

request.description: Returns the active logical shard topology and node counts.
Deterministically resolves the target logical shard for a partition key.
Simulates topology expansion and measures minimal key remapping.

item.name: Unique ID Generator
item.description: Distributed 64-bit Snowflake ID generation, batch allocation, and decomposition.

request.description: Generates a unique 64-bit distributed Snowflake identifier.
Generates a sequential batch of unique distributed IDs.
Decomposes a 64-bit Snowflake ID into timestamp, datacenter, worker, and sequence.

item.name: URL Shortener
item.description: High-throughput Base62 Snowflake URL shortening service with HTTP 302 redirection and analytics.

request.description: Shortens a destination URL into a 6-8 character Base62 link with optional expiration.
Resolves the short code and returns HTTP 302 redirect to original destination while recording click telemetry.
Inspects click count, expiration, creation timestamp, and original URL.
Retrieves the list of shortened URLs created by the authenticated customer or seller.

item.name: Web Crawler
item.description: Safe, controlled asynchronous web crawler with SSRF protection, URL deduplication, and link traversal.

request.description: Submits a new crawl job for asynchronous execution.
Polls current crawler job status (SUBMITTED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED).
Retrieves the parsed metadata, summaries, canonical URLs, and extracted outgoing links for crawled pages.
Signals the active crawler to stop further page fetching.

item.name: Competitor Price Monitoring
item.description: Controlled, lawful competitor price tracking, historical observations, and product catalog comparison.

request.description: Registers an authorized competitor/partner data source with allowed domain and CSS extraction rules.
Lists all configured competitor price sources.
Maps a local catalog product to an authorized competitor destination URL.
Compares the local product price against recent competitor observations, calculating absolute and percentage differences.
Triggers a manual extraction and observation for a mapped product.
Retrieves the historical timeline of price observations for a product mapping.
